title: workflow loop state (.workflow/state.json)
description: Single source of truth for in-run progress. Read at the start of every iteration, written at the end. Must survive transcript compaction, --resume, and crash restart — nothing here may live only in the conversation. `phases`/`currentPhase`/`gateCadence`/`gateBatchSize` are only present for a multi-phase plan (see SKILL.md's 'Multi-phase plans' section) — absent entirely for an ordinary single-phase run, so this stays backward compatible.

planBaseRef.description: The whole-plan start commit, captured once at Step 1 — distinct from each phase's own baseRef below, which is what arch-delta.sh actually diffs against.

gateCadence.description: The user's own Step 0 answer for a multi-phase plan: how often to stop and ask before starting the next phase. Never inferred — null means the question hasn't been asked yet, not a default of any kind.

gateBatchSize.description: Only meaningful when gateCadence is 'batch' — stop after every N phases.

currentPhase.description: Name of the phase currently in progress; null once every phase is done (or for a non-phased run).

phases.description: One entry per phase, in execution order. Empty/absent for a non-phased run.

criteriaNames.description: The subset of verify.sh's add_criterion names that belong to this phase — for reporting only; allPass itself is never scoped, see the 'Multi-phase plans' section.

baseRef.description: Commit hash captured when this phase began — what this phase's arch-delta.sh run diffs against.

deliveredAt.description: This phase's own delivery: a commit hash, PR URL, or date once Step 6's delivery path ran for this phase specifically. Null while still pending.
